name: Mirela's crate of books
description: Crate seven from the Saltmarch boat: eleven volumes in waxed cloth, one damp at the corner, nobody's stamp on any of them. The Glasswright's Primer is among them.
notes: mw-m97i: the impounded crate of Contraband Pages as one quest item (the eleven volumes, including The Glasswright's Primer, Illusion). Given by the quest's resolutions; taken by Mirela when delivered or kept. Placement: the customs strongroom crate for the roof and guise routes is left to mw-r5nw/mw-ily9; those routes still resolve through the books-lifted and inspector-guise-passed events. Value is nominal (quest item, never sold).
